killedBy: driver: the developer single-tick step (issue #253) routes a stepped tick's events as a simulating frame does, and its round ending through settleSteppedTick
why: A stepped tick's events go to `onEvents`, which the real state machine ignores while paused. The sim resolves a round's status only while it is `playing` and never re-emits it, so a step that ends the round leaves the world decided and the session paused on a board that can never finish, even after Resume.
